# CI test failures

Record each test failure fixed from November 21 through December 4, 2026. A caught regression identifies broken behavior. A change detector fails on an implementation change while the tested behavior still works. Record the failing evidence before removing a change detector. Keep tests for authorization, privacy, migrations and concurrency.

| Date (UTC) | Test                                               | Classification                                                            | Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 2026-11-21 | Browser closes gracefully and removes its profile  | Caught regression                                                         | Chrome could write its profile after cleanup. Pausing Chrome for two seconds after its close acknowledgement reproduced the leftover directory.                                                                                                                                              |
| 2026-11-21 | User renames a thread during title generation      | Catches a regression; the original failure was a test synchronization bug | A loaded run reached the assertion before the adapter started. Waiting for the request and advancing the test clock preserves the race. Removing the production rename guard made the corrected test fail.                                                                                   |
| 2026-11-21 | Sign-in handoff reopens its previous loopback port | Caught regression                                                         | A shuffled run failed to bind on immediate restart. Awaiting the close callback fixed scope lifetime but did not guarantee that the OS would leave the released port free. A 500-restart probe failed with EADDRINUSE alongside the full suite and passed after the other projects finished. |
| 2026-11-21 | Artifact preview reports a missing local file      | Caught regression                                                         | An ENOENT from Node in another VM context failed an instanceof check and lost its short error code. The existing preview test caught the difference when run in an isolated VM.                                                                                                              |
